instagram:
Grahak badhane ke liye kaun sa totka hai? Ye rahe 3 asli wale. Bagal wali dukaan pe bheed hai aur aapki shop khaali? Totke dono ne kiye hain. Farq in teen cheezon ka hai, aur kharcha lagbhag zero. 🪔

1. Shop ka front: bahar ki light on rakhiye, board saaf kijiye aur bade letters mein likhiye ki aap kya bechte hain. Best saamaan saamne rakhiye.

2. Pehle 5 second: phone side mein rakhiye. Khade hokar boliye, "aaiye, bataiye kya dikhaun?"

3. Counter pe chhota sa board: aaj ka offer, ya new stock aaya hai. Haath se likha bhi chalega.

Kal subah shop kholte hi start kijiye. Comment mein bataiye, aapki shop ka sabse pakka totka kaun sa hai? 👇
